title: How many students in Matagorda County schools were considered economically disadvantaged in 2024-25 school year?
text:
How many students in Matagorda County schools were considered economically disadvantaged in 2024-25 school year?
K. T. Ward
Matagorda County schools enrolled 4,346 students classified as economically disadvantaged during the 2024-25 school year, according to the Texas Education Agency.
Of the 6,951 students enrolled in Matagorda County, 62.5% were considered economically disadvantaged. This is a 12.9% decrease in the number of such students from the previous school year.
Matagorda County enrolled the 79th highest number of students identified as economically disadvantaged among Texas counties.
A 2026 study by WalletHub classified Texas as one of the least-educated states in the U.S., ranking it 41st out of 50 in educational quality and student outcomes.
Texas has the nation's second-largest K-12 public school system, serving about 5.5 million students with a student-to-teacher ratio of roughly 15:1.
